replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
As with Sweet Slopes is as to cobwebs, it seems that there are more randomly spaced obstacles within the map. The cacti are obtrusive to gameplay for everyone, and I would recommend removing them or severely limiting them to the point where the range of them isn't ~6 blocks away from each other. They're too closely placed. This doesn't include the potential navigation problems that may arise because you can't place blocks on lilypads or dead bushes.

The pyramid designs do not mesh well with the actual map, and orange-to-yellow is not a suitable aesthetic as to the sides of the map with quartz, clay, acacia logs, and lamps: I would have recommended to use those blocks rather than the same two to add more variation to spawn and the wool rooms, because right now they stick out like a sore thumb, but slightly an eyesore. I'd also say that the wool rooms need to be more expansive. 

As for the map itself, I like the middle and the trident-style layout. The little roundabout where the three lanes split off to reach the middle is a very good element, and has a lot of substance. The front lines could use some changes, however: I'd imagine that using a Rendezvous 3 style front line where there's a roof and it stairs up would be a good gameplay attribute. I would also recommend using foliage as cover in terms of the map's style: so dry, barren leaves and maybe some dead trees would mesh well with the palette.

I'd say overall good job, but there are at least some improvements I'd make before testing it.
